title: Evidence manifest
description: Describes one governance gate run: which tool produced it, which rulesets were in force, which commit was under test, when, and a digest of every artifact written. A digest shows the set has not been edited since; it shows nothing about whether a check was authorised, complete or correct.

schema.description: Identifies the format. Stable across tool versions.

schema_version.description: Version of this format, moved independently of the tool. Consumers target this.

ruleset.description: The rules that decided the outcome, fingerprinted by content rather than by version number: a version records what someone claimed, a digest records what was in force.

commit.description: Commit the run was made against, if the run knew one.

artifacts.description: Every file the run wrote, except this manifest.

note.description: States the limits of what the digests prove. Required by convention, not by schema, because a manifest that drops it is still readable — it is just less honest.
